build_luna_model: build a Luna encoder-decoder model instance using LunaModel.build_model with args and task
build_luna_encoder: build a LunaEncoder with source dictionary and token embeddings for sequence encoding
build_luna_decoder: build a LunaDecoder with target dictionary and token embeddings for sequence decoding
run_luna_forward: run the forward pass of LunaModel with src_tokens, src_lengths, and prev_output_tokens
configure_luna_architecture: configure Luna model architecture defaults using base_architecture or luna_base_untied
